# Mask

> A local-first PWA built on @niclaslindstedt/oss-framework that masks personal
> data in Swedish documents — names, street addresses, cities, postal codes,
> phone numbers, personal identity numbers, e-mail and organisation numbers —
> with placeholders you confirm, so the text can go to an LLM without the
> details, and restores the details in the answer. Nothing leaves the browser.

- App: https://mask.niclaslindstedt.se/
- Source: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/mask
- Framework: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/oss-framework

## Features

- Upload a PDF or text file, or paste text; detectors propose what to mask
- Review every candidate, fix its kind, add what was missed, confirm
- Projects remember placeholders so the same person gets the same one everywhere
- Global always-mask / never-mask lists and custom regex patterns
- Placeholder styles: AAA, aaa, $1, NAME1, [NAME 1], {{name1}}
- Paste the LLM's answer back and restore the real values
- Workspaces, themes, English/Swedish UI, installable offline PWA
